annotations.title: HelloFresh: move one week’s delivery day

description: Move ONE HelloFresh delivery week to another delivery day/slot offered for that week (the week’s oneOffDaySlots from hf_get_delivery). Keeps the box size; the plan’s regular day is unchanged (hf_change_delivery_schedule changes it for good). Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

slot.description: The slot handle from the week’s oneOffDaySlots, e.g. US-2-0800-2000 (weekday 1=Mon…7=Sun, then from/to HHMM).

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_set_week_delivery_day
